status: MECHANISM_REVIEW_ONLY; no trainedcandidate or new empiricalclaim. Complete current all-data comparison and declared gate before deciding the next scientific trial.

papers.title: Equilibrium-Constrained Estimation of Recursive Logit Choice Models
papers.read: Abstract, recursive normalization, cyclic toy example, equilibrium/flow equations.
papers.finding: Reformula la estimacion de elecciones secuenciales mediante restricciones de equilibrio. El ejemplo ciclico muestra que una normalizacion infinita puede no existir; la interpretacion de flujo requiere radio espectral menor que uno.
papers.limit: Es eleccion de rutas, no una demostracion de MAE OD en nuestra cohorte de Porto. No se implementa su optimizador conico ni se declara una replica.

papers.title: Constrained Recursive Logit for Route Choice Analysis
papers.read: Abstract, state augmentation, path feasibility, synthetic/real evaluation description.
papers.finding: Amplia el estado para representar restricciones acumuladas y normaliza decisiones entre rutas factibles sin muestrear rutas. Sus restricciones pertenecen al conjunto de alternativas del modelo.
papers.limit: No autoriza a usar el tiempo verdadero de la consulta como plazo ni a eliminar viajes dificiles de nuestra evaluacion. Un horizonte fijo puede corresponder al dominio temporal ya definido, conservando todas las filas.

papers.title: Incorporating graph neural network into route choice model
papers.read: Abstract, recursive choice equations, graph residual component, Tokyo dataset definition.
papers.finding: Combina utilidades de eleccion de rutas con informacion del grafo y componentes neuronales. La probabilidad de transicion incorpora el valor global del destino.
papers.limit: Evalua eleccion de rutas en una red agregada de Tokio; no prueba un error de tiempo OD menor de73.5s en Porto. Cambiar GRU por GNN sin cambiar la inferencia global seria una variante insuficiente.

papers.title: Integrating Knowledge into Data-driven Route Choice Modeling
papers.read: Official journal abstract, publication metadata, stated model and evaluation.
papers.finding: DR2Logit usa una utilidad neuronal y probabilidades recursivas calculadas analiticamente, con condiciones de solvencia y aprendizaje robusto.
papers.limit: Solo se verifico el resumen oficial; no se atribuyen detalles adicionales al articulo. La divergencia de flujos de rutas no equivale al MAE temporal OD.

papers.title: Bayesian Dynamic Gamma Models for Route-Level Travel Time Reliability
papers.read: Abstract, shared environment, approximate route distribution, empirical evaluation and limitations.
papers.finding: Un ambiente latente comun induce dependencia entre segmentos; la distribucion agregada de ruta usa una aproximacion por momentos.
papers.limit: Requiere una ruta y observaciones temporales de sus segmentos. La cobertura de intervalos y la evaluacion en una autopista no establecen el objetivo OD de Porto ni permiten usar retroalimentacion de Validation.

own_hypothesis_for_review.name: Global endpoint-conditioned walk-duration normalization
own_hypothesis_for_review.reason: The previous learned road rollout commits to local recurrent decisions; the failed geometric diffusion compresses path shape and time. A finite-horizon forward sum would instead marginalize all graph walks and durations jointly.
own_hypothesis_for_review.mathematics: u_n(q)=a_o^T K_0(q)...K_(n-1)(q)b_d; p(n|q)=u_n/sum_(m=4..119)u_m. Each transition corresponds to15seconds, soT=15n. This is an own discretized walk bridge, not automatically a first-passage model.
own_hypothesis_for_review.forbidden: No true queryN/T, actual query path, label-dependent horizon or path set; no new cohortfilter.
own_hypothesis_for_review.not_claimed: No novelty claim, no expected MAE claim, no empirical gatepassed, and no equivalence to a reviewed publication.
required_instruments: Independent exhaustive tiny-graph enumeration including loops and repeated destination visits.
Finite-difference gradient through normalization and duration distribution.
Proper cumulative distribution objective; do not optimize route likelihood and infer time gains without checking time.
Same fixed rawquery batch/order/singleton interface and unchanged fullrow count.
CPU/GPU feasibility before any population cache, then prospectively specified matched Train controls.
hazards: State quantization and map coverage can corrupt transition supervision.
Finite-horizon conditioning can overfavor loops and end-of-horizon mass.
Route choice improvement need not improve duration prediction.
Full graph per-query dynamic programming may be too expensive; do not persist a huge dense transition bank.
